# SANAD Engine

> Native C++23 + Vulkan 3D game engine and editor with a full Arabic RTL UI.
> A game is a .nfproj project built by the `nf` CLI, not an HTML/web project.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): hard rules for coding agents; read before writing code.
- [Docs/AI_Game_Guide.md](Docs/AI_Game_Guide.md): executable workflow, scene format, Lua API, complete mini-game.
- [README.md](README.md): build, features, screenshots, download.

## Make a game

```
build_nf.bat Release
build\Release\bin\nf.exe new Games\MyGame --name MyGame --template ThirdPerson
build\Release\bin\nf.exe run --project Games\MyGame\MyGame.nfproj
```

Verify headlessly:

```
build\Release\bin\nf.exe run --project Games\MyGame\MyGame.nfproj --frames 120 --headless --validation
```

Acceptance is exit code 0 and `Validation errors: 0`.

## Do not

- Do not create index.html, CSS, JavaScript, package.json, Electron, or a web server.
- Do not create a Unity/Godot/Unreal project.
- Do not edit Engine/ for a gameplay task.

## Key paths

- Engine: `Engine/`
- Editor: `Editor/`
- CLI (`nf`): `Tools/BuildTool/main.cpp`
- Templates: `Templates/`
- Lua API: `Docs/AI_Game_Guide.md` and `Docs/Lua_Scripting_Ar.md`
- Built binaries: `build/Release/bin/`
